decisive_items: Bilateral hyperintensity in the pulvinar region of thalami
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it has the most specific and unique support from the vignette, including low α-galactosidase activity and positive genetic testing for the pseudo-α-galactosidase allele. R4 is the runner-up because it has some support from the vignette, including autonomic dysfunction and generalized ataxia, but it is less specific than R3. The margin is medium because while R3 has strong support, R4 also has some relevant features.

rejected.why: too general, lacks specific diagnostic features
